title: IntentEventPayload
description: Payload of a WorldEvent of type `intent`: one state change of an intent, published by the Body (spec 5.3, section 7). The sink projects it into the Postgres `intents` table, moving only forward: accepted, then running, then completed, failed or cancelled. An `interrupted` event is projected as `cancelled` with an end_reason that starts `interrupted:`; `paused` is events only, because the table has no such state. The `accepted` event also carries goal, program, arguments, preconditions, wake_on and limits, which the sink stores in the same row. source_event_id derives from (intent_id, state, tick), so a retry dedups. intent_id is the id the Mind put in the plan (an `in_` id); the Body does not derive it.

detail.description: Why, in plain text, for example the failure message.
